findings.title: The staged case evidence loses its profile and dependency links
findings.evidence: tools/build_site.py:14-17 copies docs/evidence/qaizen-labs unchanged to evidence/; tools/build_site.py:23-24 rebases only the media transcripts. docs/evidence/qaizen-labs/README.md:3 links ../../../profiles/qaizen-labs.json and :20 links ../../demo/qaizen-labs/README.md, ../../showcase.md and ../../coordination-dependencies.md. Measurement on supplied site-draft: all four resolve outside the staged root to absent files, while python3 -B tools/check_site.py <site-draft> returns valid=true (25 references; 9364987 bytes). showcase/index.html:20 exposes evidence/README.md as the candidate identities/provenance/limits link. See staged-link-measurement.json.
findings.counterexample: Follow the showcase Candidate identities, provenance and remaining limits link to evidence/README.md, then follow its project-profile or coordination-dependency link. On the intended /qore-codex-skills/ deployment these relative URLs escape the project prefix, and neither destination is staged. The source checkout links work; the built public presentation links do not.
findings.remedy: Rebase the staged evidence README links to explicitly staged resources or stable candidate-specific repository URLs, and include staged Markdown links in the static closure check.
